_comment: Per-rule jsx-a11y warning counts. EMPTY: every jsx-a11y rule reached 0 and was promoted to "error" in eslint.config.js, so new violations fail the build outright and never reach a baseline. Keep this file: if a future rule is added as "warn" with an existing backlog, record it here and ratchet it down the same way. CI fails when a count RISES. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-a11y.mjs --write-baseline
